messages:
mira (design): quick check: propose moving the sim legend into a slim left rail that pins to rule groups. avoids overlaying long rule text. thoughts?

ash (pm): sounds good. main worry is cramped vertical space on 13-inch laptops.

rene (frontend): collapse by default on small widths. add a toggle with aria-expanded. also need clear keyboard order between rail and canvas.

priya (a11y): ensure rail has role="region" and an accessible name. avoid color-only signals; include numeric priority too.

mira (design): agree on numbers. copy question: short badge "High" vs "High priority"?

ash (pm): "High" is fine for compact view; use "High priority" in hover tooltip.

rene (frontend): for validation during sim, prefer inline messages under rule name, not ephemeral toasts. toasts are easy to miss while interacting.

priya (a11y): inline + aria-describedby is good. debounce announcements (800ms) so screen readers don't spam. also ensure focus doesn't jump when messages update.

mira (design): drag handles: tests show people miss hover-only handles. propose always-visible micro-handle in compact list.

rene (frontend): micro-handle 20-24px, pointer-events only on handle to avoid accidental drags. on touch, long-press reorder.

ash (pm): also add a global run summary toast after simulation: "1 error, 2 warnings" — aria-atomic so it's read fully.

copy-bot: suggested copy for tooltip: "Drag to reorder rules. Higher priority runs first." (under 50 chars)

priya (a11y): final checklist: region roles, aria-labels for legend items, numeric labels for priority, contrast >=4.5, aria-live polite for sim status with debounce.

mira (design): action items: Rene implement rail + collapse + inline validation; Priya publish a11y checklist; Ash lock copy; I'll update mocks and add compact/mobile variants. Review in design-sync tomorrow. :thumbsup:
